items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: That's Covington we're taking at you... We was, we was out, we was drinking... we all agreed to him to take the picture.

ctx.x: Yes. You know that picture taken with you and Buddy Petit over there in Mandeville?
That's Covington we're taking at you.
That's Covington. Can you remember the circumstances under which that picture was taken or, you know, anything about it to enlarge upon that picture at all? I mean, to describe the circumstances?
